evidence.name: Screen field: Override mobile keyboard input type
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Override mobile keyboard input type" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Override mobile keyboard input type
sections.description: Forces a specific keyboard on mobile devices (Email, Numeric, Decimal, Phone, URL, etc.). Leave as Auto (from field type) to let the system derive keyboard type from Field Type setting.
